title: Even moment bound by compatible labelings
statement: Let $n,r,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$ whose nonzero Fourier coefficients are all at level $k$. Its $2r$-th moment under the uniform measure is at most $(k!)^{-2r}$ times the sum, over all perfect matchings of the complete $2r$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part together with vertex labelings by $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ that agree across every matching edge, of the product over the $2r$ parts of the absolute Fourier coefficient indexed by the set of labels appearing in that part.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the sign cube of dimension $n$
every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $f$ is at level $k$
